entities.name: Natacha Ngoye Akamabi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Natacha Ngoye Akamabi is a Congolese sprinter. She won two gold medals at the 2017 Jeux de la Francophonie. She also represented her country in the 400 metres at the 2012 World Indoor Championships without advancing from the first round.
